channel.title: Hermes Atlas — new projects
channel.description: Newly added community-built tools, skills, plugins, and integrations for Nous Research's Hermes Agent. Updated daily.

item.title: agent-context-os (Memory & Context)
item.description: Context OS is a Git-backed context and workflow layer that stores project instructions, decisions, and handoffs in Markdown files for coding agents. It uses a deterministic lifecycle kernel to manage state transitions and context proposals across multiple supported runtimes.

item.title: hermes-tool-slimmer (Memory & Context)
item.description: Hermes Tool Slimmer is a schema-selection optimization tool that reduces the token overhead caused by large tool catalogs in Hermes Agent. It creates an indexable corpus of tool schemas and uses local BM25 ranking with explicit boosts to select the smallest useful tool set for each turn. This approach lowers prompt token consumption while providing a dashboard for diagnostics, counters, and visibility. item.title: ekko-studio (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Ekko Studio, formerly Hermes Studio, is a local-first AI workspace and web console that provides a unified interface for multiple agent runtimes including Hermes, Ekko, and Claude Code. It supports multi-agent chat, visual workflow automation with human approval gates, and centralized management of platform channels like Telegram, Discord, and Slack.

item.title: incise (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Incise is a CLI and agent-tool backend designed for precise, byte-preserving updates to Markdown files. It allows AI agents to modify tables, lists, sections, and YAML frontmatter using semantic addresses rather than line numbers to ensure targeted edits.

item.title: leverage (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Leverage provides a registry of skills and packaged workflows for AI agents, enabling them to access live social media data, company enrichment, and outreach tools. It integrates with agents via the agentskills.io standard and an MCP server to provide structured data from platforms like LinkedIn, X, and Reddit.

item.title: llm-wiki-cli (Memory & Context)
item.description: LWC is an agent-driven command-line interface that enables AI agents to maintain persistent, source-grounded knowledge across sessions. Built in Rust with an SQLite backend, it allows agents to autonomously manage a wiki containing citations, links, and history without requiring embeddings or vector databases.

item.title: token-saver (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Token Saver is a Hermes Agent plugin that calculates the hypothetical cost of local AI inference based on live OpenRouter pricing. It tracks token usage from local providers like Ollama and LM Studio to visualize simulated savings through a web dashboard, TUI widget, and slash commands.

item.title: deja-vu (Memory & Context)
item.description: deja-vu is a memory tool for coding agents that indexes session history already stored on a user's disk. It allows agents to search and retrieve past solutions across different platforms using millisecond lookups and an MCP-compatible architecture.

item.title: smartnumbers-hermes (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: This Hermes plugin receives and archives Smartnumbers conversation transcripts in a local SQLite database. It enables automated post-call agent reviews and natural-language callbacks by queuing one-shot cron tasks that utilize Hermes' configured toolsets.

item.title: hermes-codex-skin (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Codex Skin is an independent community plugin for Hermes Desktop that applies a Codex-inspired visual layout while maintaining native application behavior. It provides a selectable theme for original Codex colors and supports native Hermes themes, including Glass and Clear window translucency.

item.title: hermes-memoss (Developer Tools)
item.description: MemOS Memory Plugin for Hermes Agent connects to a self-hosted MemOS instance to provide persistent memory storage. It enables semantic search, fact extraction, and automatic synchronization of conversation turns.

item.title: hermes-hud (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Hermes HUD is a local-first, read-only dashboard plugin for the Hermes Agent that provides real-time monitoring of system health, token usage, and session activity. It operates as a user-level extension that integrates with the official dashboard via a shared snapshot cache and WebSocket event stream without modifying the core agent.

item.title: hermes-hud (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Hermes HUD is a terminal-based consciousness monitor and dashboard for Hermes AI agents. It reads data from the agent's local directory to display live information regarding memory, tool usage, project status, and error logs.

item.title: skill-evolution (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Skill Evolution is a Python-based framework for autonomous agent skill improvement that analyzes past sessions to generate structured proposals. It features an evaluation gate with multiple evaluators and host-agnostic adapters for Hermes and Claude Code.

item.title: cli (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: @sandbaseai/cli is a command-line tool and local bridge that uses the Model Context Protocol to connect AI agents to over 2,000 models and APIs. It enables agents to access web search, social media data, and real-time information through a single browser-based authorization.

item.title: hermes-ai-usage (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes AI Usage Monitor is a read-only extension for Hermes Agent that provides telemetry for provider quotas and local token usage. It supports the native Desktop app and Web Dashboard, displaying session history and consumption metrics without reading prompt or message content.

item.title: hermes-speech (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Speech is a plugin for Hermes Agent 0.20+ that integrates text-to-speech and speech-to-text capabilities through the AllModels API. It enables conversational setup, voice searching, and streaming audio using Hermes' native provider interfaces and bundled dependencies.

item.title: hermes-live-voice (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Live Voice is a self-hosted realtime voice gateway and dashboard plugin for Hermes Agent that enables continuous voice interaction during background task execution. It manages task supervision, progress streaming, and client protocols while delegating speech processing to local or hosted realtime providers.

item.title: agent-skills (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: agent-skills provides a collection of markdown-based workflow patterns for coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode. These skills enable specific procedures including session management, code review orchestration, and state drift reconciliation through drop-in directory installation.

item.title: agent-memory-kit (Memory & Context)
item.description: agent-memory-kit is a file-based curation loop designed to identify contradictions and outdated information within an agent's memory store. It uses a set of five markdown-based commands to capture, recall, and audit memory through evidence-cited diffs without requiring a database or vector store.

item.title: hermes-startup (Developer Tools)
item.description: Hermes Startup is a local-first skill for Hermes Agent designed to help users identify and test business ideas. The tool uses a series of focused questions to generate evidence-labeled ideas and prepares reversible tests for chosen problems.

item.title: demo-gif-skill (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: This project is a skill for Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents that automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories. It generates recording scripts using vhs for terminal interfaces or Playwright for web applications, then renders, optimizes, and embeds the resulting GIF into the README.

item.title: agent-skill-builder (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: agent-skill-builder is a tool for generating and validating Claude Code and portable Agent Skills using plain-language descriptions. It includes a runtime-aware validator that detects structural drift, unsafe commands, and credential-shaped strings while enforcing specific character limits for each profile.

item.title: incontext (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: incontext is a Hermes Agent plugin that dynamically budgets output space against the active context boundary. It inserts an output cap when remaining space meets a configured reserve or caller-supplied limit, otherwise leaving the request unchanged to avoid truncated responses.

item.title: hermes-appearance-hub (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Appearance Hub is a desktop plugin that consolidates appearance settings and dialogue behaviors into a single status bar pop-up. It provides custom themes, paper texture simulation, and integration for LXGW WenKai fonts without modifying the application's core code.

item.title: hermes-agent (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Scavio for Hermes Agent provides structured web data from 31 platforms and an Extract endpoint via a hosted MCP server. It includes five ready-to-use skills and is compatible with clients following the Agent Skills standard.

item.title: hermes-bounty-board (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: hermes-bounty-board is a Python plugin for Hermes Agent that enables users to earn USDC by answering support bounties or managing their own bounty boards. The system uses x402 over HTTP for payments, requiring no accounts or API keys, and automatically distributes 85% of the reward to the submitting wallet upon human approval.

item.title: hermes-connector (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Connector is an open-source Chrome extension that enables a local Hermes Agent to read and control specific, user-selected browser tabs. It uses a version-matched companion application to route requests between a Hermes profile and the browser without relying on hidden automation tools.

item.title: hermes-windows-runtime-skills (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: This community-maintained skill pack for Hermes Agent provides deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL. It enables agents to identify execution domains and verify existing Python interpreters without installing new software or modifying project files.

item.title: Life_OS (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Life OS is a personal management system that uses an AI agent to design and maintain habits, tasks, and goals while the user completes them via a tap-based interface. The software runs locally using Node.js and SQLite, requiring no account or cloud synchronization.
